children: Georgia Banking Company filed an S-1 for a direct listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker "GBC." The filing registers the resale of up to 7,040,514 shares by existing shareholders and is not underwritten. The company will not receive proceeds from these sales, and listing is contingent on Nasdaq approval.

Georgia Banking Company is a Georgia-based bank holding company focused on relationship-driven commercial and community banking across the Atlanta metropolitan area. Through its wholly owned bank subsidiary, the company offers commercial lending, commercial real estate financing, mortgage warehouse lending, private banking, treasury services (including merchant acquiring and high-volume ACH), and retail mortgage solutions.

The bank’s model emphasizes local decision-making, senior-level responsiveness, and tailored credit and treasury solutions for small and middle-market businesses. Since a 2021 recapitalization, the company has expanded its branch network, completed two strategic acquisitions, and scaled technology and risk infrastructure to support growth. Complementary lines of business—particularly treasury services and mortgage warehouse lending—provide diversified fee and interest income, while the company’s local market focus seeks to capture share displaced by consolidation among larger banks.
: The Atlanta MSA held approximately $239.8 billion of deposits as of June 30, 2025.
: The Atlanta region’s population grew about 0.96% from 2024 to 2025 and has added nearly 400,000 residents since 2020.
: The company estimates a 1.13% Atlanta deposit share as of mid-2026, positioning itself among a small group of locally headquartered mid-size banks.
: Large national and super-regional banks, community banks, credit unions, fintech and payments providers, and digital asset platforms.
: Ongoing consolidation, rising compliance requirements, demand for treasury and payments solutions, and technology-driven customer expectations.
: Focus on small and middle-market businesses, professionals, entrepreneurs, and families within the Atlanta MSA
: 10 full-service branches and three loan production offices as of June 30, 2026
: Concentrated in the Atlanta-Sandy Springs-Roswell, GA MSA
: Network affiliations with Visa/Mastercard and ACH operators for merchant acquiring and payments
: Mortgage warehouse average outstanding balance of approximately $438 million in H1 2026
: 275 full-time equivalent employees; $3.3 billion in assets, ~$2.8 billion in deposits, and ~$2.6 billion in total loans (including held for sale) as of June 30, 2026
: $112.7 million total revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) in 2025
: $22.1 million in 2025; $13.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026
, Chief Executive Officer - Former CEO of BrandBank; led the company’s 2021 recapitalization and strategic transformation; extensive experience in Atlanta banking markets.
, President & Chief Operating Officer - More than 35 years of banking leadership; previously President & COO at BrandBank; oversees operations, IT, deposit and loan operations, and treasury services.
, Chief Financial Officer - Joined in 2026; formerly Chairman, President, and CEO of Tandem Bank; prior experience in community banking, capital markets, and investment banking.
, Chief Commercial Officer - Former Chief Risk Officer of the bank; prior senior roles at multiple regional banks; oversees commercial, CRE, warehouse, private and community banking production.
, Chief Risk Officer & Chief Credit Officer - Over 20 years of commercial banking and investment management experience; previously Director of Credit Risk at the bank.
, Chief Human Resources Officer - Over 30 years in financial services; led human capital and organizational initiatives at major U.S. banks.
, Chief Accounting Officer - Joined in 2026; prior senior accounting leadership at Veritex and public accounting at Ernst & Young; CPA.
, Chief Experience Officer - Leads customer and employee experience strategy, marketing, and culture; 25+ years in financial services marketing and engagement.
: Up to 7,040,514 shares (registered for resale in a direct listing)
: The company will not receive any proceeds from the sale of common stock by the registered shareholders.
